items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: My cousin, Chuck, he plays bass.

ctx.x: Yeah, Mr. Russell don't go for it. Good kids open and Williams, the best talent player they had. I heard a lot of people talk about him.
That's right. Any other friends play? No, there's no one. I got any more friends. Sisters? Us three actually. No. My cousin, Chuck, he plays bass.
Oh, what am I telling you is he's a cousin? My first cousin, my cousin. My first cousin. My first cousin. My first cousin. My first cousin. My first cousin.
